excludes: one identical excluded warmup cohort per fresh server

pilot.cohort_arrival: single atomic prompt-array /completion request, original fixture index order, identical client for A/P

cpu25.historical_definition: matches original study: 12.5ms process CPU per 50ms period, CPU10, normal Linux priority

pool_delta.baseline: GGML_NEWA_POOL=off, disposable GGML pools; default poll=50; normal priority and unrestricted role masks
pool_delta.candidate: GGML_NEWA_POOL=donor, persistent generation5/batch6 pools; poll=50 both; initially paused; normal priority; no per-role masks
pool_delta.legacy_on: Existing on/max(5,6)/poll0 retained in source but excluded from primary comparison

kernel_and_resource_policy: same E worker threshold/continuity/fallback, Q4/Q6 arithmetic, sampler, FA/KV; record GGML_NEWA_* and NEWA_DECODE_RESOURCE explicitly; compare decision counters as a pool-policy interaction
auxiliary_metrics: prefill/decode rates with actual tokens and execution intervals
correctness_gate: both distinct cohorts free-generation token equality with R
diagnostic disposable pool absence in steady state (separate from timing)

decision_rule.PILOT_PROMISING: positive mean and bootstrap lower>0, >=3/4 faster in both conditions with all functional gates; not a 5% guarantee
decision_rule.PILOT_REGRESSION: negative mean and bootstrap upper<0 in any primary condition; preserve other conditions separately
decision_rule.PILOT_INCONCLUSIVE: otherwise, including partial conditions or measurement invalidity

confirmation: Propose one separate confirmation as a next step only; do not auto-run or combine techniques
